Device_time: Timestamp of the sample generated by the iot device for a given pump
api: api identifier of the iot device software for a given pump
Device_serial_no: iot device serial number that identifies the pump too
Ambient_temperature: Ambient temperature measurement produced by the iot device for a given pump
Oil_temperature: Pump internal oil temperature measurement produced by the iot device for a given pump
Inlet_pressure: Pump inlet pressure measurement produced by the iot device for a given pump
Exhaust_pressure: Pump exhaust pressure measurement produced by the iot device for a given pump
Vibration_level: Pump vibration measurement produced by the iot device for a given pump
Pump_type: Pump type from these values: PLUS, RA 1000 B, RA 0305 D, ECOT, RA 0630 C, RA 0010 B, RD 0360 A, MV 0312 B, BASIC, MM 1502 AV, ...
Pump_id: Global unique identifier of the pump
Pump_product_family: Pump product family from these values: PANDA, R5, COBRA, DOLPHIN, MINK, PUMA, TYR, COBRA , COMBI, R5 COMBI, SECO
Country: Name of the country where the pump is installed
Organization_id: Global unique identifier of the organization where the pump is installed. Organization means customer.
Organization_name: Name of the organization, or customer, where the pump is installed.
Regional_office_id: Regional office global unique identifier, in charge of the given pump.
Exhaust_temperature: Pump exhaust temperature measurement produced by the iot device for a given pump
Power: Pump power consumption measurement produced by the iot device for a given pump
